name: pr-review
description: A project tab that reviews a pull request as a guided, staged discussion: a walkthrough, a quality pass, the key changes a few files at a time, then a skim pile, with a chat beside the code. Claude (through Claude Code) reviews by default, or a local Ollama model. The review is posted to GitHub or sent to Firstmate only when you click.

backend.title: Reviewer
backend.description: Who reviews: Claude through Claude Code’s headless mode (claude -p, with none of your hooks, tools or MCP servers), or a local model through Ollama.

claudeModel.title: Claude model
claudeModel.description: The model Claude Code reviews with, such as sonnet, opus or a full model id.

ollamaModel.title: Ollama model
ollamaModel.description: The Ollama model each stage runs on when the reviewer is Ollama, such as qwen2.5:7b or llama3.1.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama address
ollamaUrl.description: Where Ollama answers on this computer, when the reviewer is Ollama.

contextTokens.title: Context window (tokens)
contextTokens.description: How much an Ollama model reads at once: at least 4096. Bigger reads more of a stage’s diff but needs more memory.

extraGenerated.title: Also hide as generated
extraGenerated.description: File names (a * matches any part of a name), paths, or folders ending in /, hidden like build output. dist/, build/, lockfiles and snapshots are always hidden.
